name: Mama Odie's Creamy Tomato Soup
whyItWorks: Blended completely smooth with cream so there are zero tomato skins or seeds, though tomato acidity makes it best suited for steady/remission days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order only when stomach/duodenal ulcers are quiet; dip soft white dinner rolls and take a Lactaid enzyme for the cream base.
flareEmergencySwap: Ask your server for plain chicken broth or the smooth potato/butternut soup from a neighboring kitchen instead.
